messages.text:
Hello. I have placed an order. I am aware that you cannot list a price on
the invoice that is lower than the one shown on your website; however,
could you at least avoid specifying on the invoice that this is a
cryptocurrency mining machine? Perhaps you could label it as a
"mini-server" or something similar instead? Also, will the shipment be
handled by DHL?
Handed to the team · Customs paperwork wording is not mine to change; needs Georges.

Hi Vasiliy,

Thanks for your order, and for asking up front rather than after the fact.

On the invoice wording: the declared value has to stay as paid, as you say, and the goods have to be described accurately, so I cannot promise you a "mini-server" line. What exactly goes on the export paperwork is Georges' call, not mine, so I have passed your request to him and he is picking it up today. He will reply to you in this thread with what we can and cannot put on the documents for Uzbekistan.

On the carrier: your confirmation shows DHL, and that is what we normally use for your region out of our US warehouse. The tracking number comes to you by email the moment the label is on the box. Your Harlo B30 is a pre-sale unit and ships October 30, 2026.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hello. If possible, please keep the original Thor firmware installed—do not
install Harlo OS. Also, please make sure to check the device before
shipping it. Thank you.

Handed to the team · Firmware build shipped on the unit is not something I can set or promise.

Hi Vasiliy,

Noted, and both requests are on your order now.

On the firmware: I cannot promise that myself, because what is flashed on the unit is set by the warehouse and our technical lead, not by me. I have passed your request to leave it on the original Thor firmware, with Harlo OS not installed, straight to them, and a colleague is picking it up today and will confirm here before the unit goes out.

On the check before shipping: your order includes the Harlo OS Diagnostics and 3-Month RMA line, so the unit is bench checked before it leaves us. I have added your note so the person handling it sees it, and if anything looks off on that check we will tell you rather than ship it.

Your B30 ships October 30, 2026, and the tracking comes to you by email the moment the label is on the box.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

That's great, thank you.
